page.layout: One block: a printed library label in the lower middle of the page. Handwriting above it (ownership inscription, date and shelf mark) is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Mrs. Robert Lenox Kennedy Church History Fund.

page.notes: Handwritten, not transcribed: the ownership inscription at the top ("Guilhelmus Tenselig", with "Zierikzee" above and "emptg. i. Rixdaler" or similar, "Anno 16.. 15 Junii", a crossed-out "Philippi" and "Nicolai", and a brown stain over part of the line), the shelf mark "Heidelberg" with a number, and the handwritten "10.3.99" at the upper right of the label. Also handwritten on the label: "SCD" under Division and "1074" under Section. Parts of the handwriting are illegible or doubtful, so I have not transcribed them.
